notes: S'mores, pineapple upside-down, egg-white-only angel food in a tube pan, cassava tapioca, Baked Alaska/49th state all accurate; 'heavenly' is a warm nudge, not a leak.

name: MAKE A JOYFUL NOISE
notes: All five lyric quotes verified and unambiguous; 'this 1913 hymn' for The Old Rugged Cross softened to 'completed in 1913' since sources split 1912-written/1913-completed (web-verified); re-scored 47.

name: FUN AT THE FAIR

name: OUR NECK OF THE WOODS

name: GRANDMA'S CURE-ALLS
notes: 'Jewish penicillin', cobalt-blue Vicks jar, pink calamine, castor-bean laxative, mustard plaster on flannel all accurate old-remedy lore; perfectly pitched for a 75-year-old.
